news.title: Man critically injured in DeKalb County hit-and-run crash
news.summary: A man is fighting for his life after a driver struck him and fled the scene in DeKalb County on Saturday night.

news.title: Atlanta to gather for vigil to remember woman, dog brutally killed in Piedmont Park 5 years after murders
news.summary: Katie Janness' killing approaches, family, friends and community members are preparing to gather in her memory while once again calling for answers.

news.title: Officer buys meal for homeless veteran after chance encounter
news.summary: The Duluth Police Department is recognizing one of its officers after a simple act of kindness toward a homeless military veteran.

news.title: Activists gather at ICE Atlanta field office after recent deaths
news.summary: Community members gathered outside the ICE Atlanta field office for a candlelight vigil honoring people who died while in federal custody or during agency operations.

news.title: Police drone helps catch armed suspect before he sees officers coming
news.summary: Snellville police say a department drone helped officers safely arrest an armed suspect accused of pointing a gun at a woman and damaging her vehicle.

news.title: DeKalb County police searching for missing 14-year-old boy
news.summary: DeKalb County police are asking for the public's help to find 14-year-old Chase, who went missing on July 24 after leaving Hyatt Circle wearing a black hoodie, blue track pants, and blue Nike slides.

news.title: Inman Park public indecency case leads to suspect surrender
news.summary: A 34-year-old man turned himself in to Atlanta police after a woman reported seeing him exposing himself along an Inman Park sidewalk.
